visual_review.method: assistant visual inspection of equal-XY-scale paired native/inverted TRAIN samples
visual_review.orientation_supported: y-up source coordinates mapped to image y-down by inversion
visual_review.basis: Inverted rows 1,18,19 have conventional digit-2 top curve and lower baseline; digit-5 rows 8,12,20, digit-6 rows 5,24,42, digit-7 rows 14,32,40 and digit-9 rows 10,13,17 also support inversion. Native counterparts are vertically reversed.

limitations: Digits-only source QA, not population recognition probabilities, writer/device/formula acceptance, or an accuracy improvement. Orientation is a visual inference, not verified author metadata.
